# OpenAtlas

> OpenAtlas is a curated, open directory of free APIs and open datasets. Every entry links to the original source and states the pricing model, access requirements (API key or none), and usage limits, with a verification date per entry. The catalog is free to reuse under the MIT license.

Canonical site: https://michaels1011.github.io/openatlasmap/
Language: English (interface and catalog); a German interface is available at https://michaels1011.github.io/openatlasmap/de/ (catalog entries stay in English)
Audience: students, educators, indie developers, and researchers looking for free data and API sources.

## Key resources

- [Home / catalog](https://michaels1011.github.io/openatlasmap/): browse and search all entries by category, pricing, and access.
- [Katalog auf Deutsch](https://michaels1011.github.io/openatlasmap/de/): deutschsprachige Oberfläche für dasselbe Verzeichnis; Einträge bleiben englisch.
- [About](https://michaels1011.github.io/openatlasmap/about/): mission and the four curation rules (free to use, original source only, no duplicates, verified with a date).
- [openatlas.json](https://michaels1011.github.io/openatlasmap/openatlas.json): the full catalog as machine-readable open data (MIT), including name, url, description, category, type, pricing, access, limitation, and verifiedAt per entry.
- [llms-full.txt](https://michaels1011.github.io/openatlasmap/llms-full.txt): the same catalog as plain text, optimized for LLM context windows.
- [Suggest a resource](https://github.com/MichaelS1011/openatlasmap/issues/new?title=Suggest%20a%20free%20API%20or%20dataset): community submissions via GitHub issues.
- [Source code](https://github.com/MichaelS1011/openatlasmap): MIT-licensed.

## How to cite OpenAtlas

Cite the individual entry page (canonical URL under /resources/<id>) and the original provider URL; the catalog itself may be cited as "OpenAtlas — Discover Free APIs & Open Data, https://michaels1011.github.io/openatlasmap/". Pricing and availability can change; the original source is always authoritative.
